base.explanation: Paris is selected as the single base city for your trip starting April 15, 2027. Estimated costs are rough group totals in EUR minor units. Please confirm this city and dates before proceeding with the itinerary.

plan.explanation: This itinerary for Paris fully respects your preferences for culture and food while avoiding multi-city travel and nightclubs. The estimated costs fit comfortably within your 2500 EUR budget, leaving a healthy reserve. Musée d'Orsay is scheduled during published opening hours, and all daily activities respect your pace and travel buffers.
plan.introduction: Welcome to Paris for a delightful four-day escape blending rich cultural heritage, world-class art at the Musée d'Orsay, charming neighborhood walks, and exceptional culinary experiences.

days.title: Arrival in Paris and Evening Stroll

activities.title: Latin Quarter Neighborhood Walk
activities.description: Enjoy a gentle afternoon introductory walk through the historic Latin Quarter, soaking in the vibrant atmosphere and charming historic streets as you settle into Paris.

activities.title: Classic Parisian Bistro Dinner
activities.description: Indulge in your first authentic food experience with a delightful multi-course dinner at a traditional Parisian bistro in Saint-Germain, savoring classic French flavors.

days.title: Art at Musée d'Orsay and Montmartre

activities.title: Morning Coffee and Croissant
activities.description: Begin your full day with a relaxed traditional Parisian breakfast featuring freshly baked pastries and café au lait at a classic local café.

activities.title: Musée d’Orsay Masterpieces Tour
activities.description: Explore the world's largest collection of Impressionist and Post-Impressionist masterpieces housed in a magnificent former railway station.

activities.title: Bistro Lunch near Orsay
activities.description: Relax and enjoy a fulfilling midday dining experience featuring seasonal French cuisine in a cozy neighborhood restaurant near the river.

activities.title: Montmartre Neighborhood Walk
activities.description: Stroll through the artistic hilltop village of Montmartre, admiring historic winding streets, quaint squares, and sweeping views over the Parisian skyline.

days.title: Historic Le Marais and Culinary Exploration

activities.title: Le Marais Historic Walk
activities.description: Discover the architectural charm and medieval history of Le Marais, exploring elegant squares, historic townhouses, and bustling boutiques.

activities.title: Traditional French Bakery and Pastry Tasting
activities.description: Sample artisan breads and signature pastries at a renowned local patisserie as part of an immersive culinary exploration.

activities.title: Seine Riverbank Stroll
activities.description: Take a scenic walk along the iconic banks of the Seine, browsing traditional bouquiniste bookstalls and admiring the historic bridges.

activities.title: Culinary Dinner Experience
activities.description: Conclude your full exploration days with an exceptional dinner celebrating contemporary French gastronomy and seasonal local ingredients.

activities.title: Final Parisian Morning Cafe
activities.description: Savor a peaceful final morning coffee and fresh pastry at a neighborhood café while reflecting on your wonderful Parisian journey.

activities.title: Souvenir Stroll in Central Paris
activities.description: Take a leisurely final walk through central avenues to pick up last-minute gifts before heading towards your return travel.
